annotations.title: Explain where an address's risk comes from

description: Explain WHERE an address's AML risk comes from: for each risk source (sanctioned entity, hack, mixer, scam, frozen funds) the chain of wallets the money took from that source to this address, hop by hop, with the label of each wallet, the amounts and assets on each link, dates and transaction hashes. Use it when the user asks why an address is risky, where its risk or dirty money came from, or through whom the funds arrived. Read-only.

address.description: The address whose risk to explain.

chain.description: Blockchain: bitcoin, ethereum, bsc or tron.

max_paths.description: How many risk sources to walk, highest-scoring first. Default 3.
